themes.name: Precious Metals
themes.description: Rare, naturally occurring metallic elements with high economic value, such as gold, silver, and platinum, used in jewelry, investment, and industrial applications.

linked_companies.name: NEWMONT CORP
linked_companies.description: Engages in the extensive exploration, extraction, and processing of gold, silver, and other precious metals across a global portfolio of mining assets, serving as a primary supplier of these commodities to the market.
linked_companies.evidence: Newmont operates primarily around precious metals extraction, generating 1.3 million ounces of gold and 9 million ounces of silver during the first quarter of 2026. Guided by operations across Cadia, Yanacocha, and Peñasquito, the company maintains the industry's largest gold reserves and officially ranks as the world's third-largest silver producer. Gold and silver outputs drive the majority of Newmont's financial performance, supported by billions in combined quarterly sales and a $1.4 billion full-year development budget explicitly targeting precious metal asset expansions. Executive leadership and organizational structures are firmly aligned with this focus, deploying dedicated underground site personnel and cross-functional operational expertise to fulfill a full-year production target of 5.3 million ounces of gold.

linked_companies.name: ROYAL GOLD INC
linked_companies.description: Acquires and manages precious metal stream and royalty interests, providing capital to mining operators in exchange for a share of future gold, silver, and other precious metal production.
linked_companies.evidence: Royal Gold's overarching business strategy relies entirely on precious metals, which recently constituted 87% of its total revenue through a 71% and 16% split between gold and silver streams. To expand this core pillar, management executes large-scale capital allocations, expanding its revolving credit facility to $2 billion to support major acquisitions like the Kansanshi and Sandstorm gold streams, alongside a $100 million commitment to secure noncore precious metals at the Warintza project. This specialized streaming and royalty framework structurally insulates the firm from direct operating cost inflation, securing its self-reported position as having the highest gold revenue concentration among its large-cap peers.

linked_companies.name: HECLA MINING CO
linked_companies.description: Operates as a primary producer of precious metals, focusing on the exploration, extraction, and development of silver and gold mining properties.
linked_companies.evidence: Hecla Mining operates exclusively as an extractor of precious metals, structurally positioned as North America's premium silver producer. The company derives approximately 87% of its total sales from this industry, with silver accounting for 73% of revenue and gold contributing the remainder through byproduct sales at sites like Greens Creek. Executive leadership directs the firm's capital directly into precious metal expansion, highlighted by a recent $40 to $50 million investment in a silver and gold recovery circuit at Greens Creek, alongside advanced drilling campaigns at the Aurora and Midas projects. This operational alignment, further reinforced by the strategic divestment of the Casa Berardi mine to concentrate on primary silver assets, dictates the company's entire business strategy and resource allocation.

linked_companies.name: COEUR MINING INC
linked_companies.description: Engages in the exploration, development, and extraction of gold and silver across multiple mining assets, directly contributing to the global supply of precious metals.
linked_companies.evidence: Coeur Mining defines its foundational corporate identity as a strictly North American-only precious metals platform, structuring its entire workforce and executive leadership around gold and silver extraction. The company recently advanced this strategy through the high-impact integration of New Gold, adding the New Afton and Rainy River mines to drive an expected 80% year-over-year increase in 2026 gold production to approximately 750,000 ounces. Coupled with output levels that place the company among the top five global silver producers, precious metals act as an absolute pure-play driver for the business, generating up to 98% of its total consolidated sales revenue.

linked_companies.name: FRESNILLO PLC
linked_companies.description: Focuses on the exploration, extraction, and processing of primary silver and gold, driving the global supply of precious metals through its active mining operations and development projects.
linked_companies.evidence: Fresnillo's business model is entirely dedicated to the extraction of precious metals, operating as the world's largest primary silver producer and Mexico's largest gold producer across eight active mines. In the first quarter of 2026, the company reported production of 11.12 million ounces of silver and 136,074 ounces of gold, maintaining a full-year gold production guidance of 500,000 to 550,000 ounces. To sustain this market leadership and support ongoing extraction, Fresnillo is investing heavily in physical infrastructure, such as the commissioning of phase XV leaching pads at Herradura and the Jarillas shaft at Saucito, alongside active workforce expansion and optimization initiatives.

themes.name: Mineral Rights
themes.description: Legal entitlements allowing individuals or companies to explore and extract mineral resources from the land.

linked_companies.name: BLACK STONE MINERALS LP
linked_companies.description: Focuses on the ownership and management of oil and natural gas mineral and royalty interests, generating revenue through the leasing of subsurface rights for exploration and production activities.
linked_companies.evidence: Black Stone Minerals' operations center on acquiring and managing oil and natural gas mineral interests, highlighted by its active marketing of 300,000 gross mineral acres. The company's strategic commitment to this asset class is directed by a dedicated executive team at Black Stone Minerals GP L.L.C. and supported by a cumulative capital deployment of over $250 million since 2023, including $12 million in the second quarter of 2026 to expand its Haynesville and Shelby Trough acreage. This targeted investment program drives the firm's core output, yielding a recent mineral and royalty production rate of 35.9 MBoe per day, which constitutes 97% of its total volume. By maintaining an industry-leading inventory spanning 41 states and over 71,000 producing wells, the organization derives nearly all of its revenue from the continual leasing and active management of these land entitlements.

linked_companies.name: KIMBELL ROYALTY PARTNERS LP
linked_companies.description: Owns and acquires mineral and royalty interests in oil and natural gas properties, generating revenue by leasing these assets to exploration and production operators.
linked_companies.evidence: Kimbell Royalty Partners operates strictly as a consolidator in the U.S. oil and natural gas royalty sector, deriving all of its recent $82.9 million operating revenue directly from mineral rights and royalty assets. The company holds a wide operational footprint with over 17 million aggregate gross acres across 28 states, translating to ownership interests in over 133,000 wells and capturing a 16% market share of all active U.S. land rigs. Expansion remains the central mechanism of Kimbell's corporate strategy, evidenced by ongoing evaluations of M&A packages and a recent $230 million acquisition of subsurface entitlements beneath the Mabee Ranch. By functioning solely as a mineral owner overseen by a specialized executive team, the company consolidates assets in an estimated $850 billion market while benefiting from a zero-capital-expenditure model that avoids operational costs like test pilot programs.

linked_companies.name: VIPER ENERGY INC-CL A
linked_companies.description: Focuses on the acquisition, ownership, and management of mineral and royalty interests in oil and natural gas properties, generating revenue through the leasing and development of these assets.
linked_companies.evidence: Viper Energy operates exclusively under a mineral and royalty model, generating its top-line revenue through the perpetual ownership and leasing of mineral entitlements. The company executes this mandate by consolidating private equity-backed mineral positions, highlighted by the recent Riverbend transaction that added over 3,000 net royalty acres to its portfolio for $337 million in cash and 3.7 million shares. Dedicated internal teams manage tens of thousands of leases and target proprietary assets, leveraging areas like Spanish Trail where Viper holds 100% of the underlying minerals to capture unquantified upside without additional capital requirements. This ongoing Permian Basin expansion builds upon over $8 billion in previous mineral acquisitions, systematically securing rights from the surface of the earth to the center of the earth.

linked_companies.name: TEXAS PACIFIC LAND CORP
linked_companies.description: Derives revenue from managing and leasing extensive landholdings for oil and gas exploration, retaining royalty interests and surface rights that directly capitalize on mineral extraction activities.
linked_companies.evidence: Texas Pacific Land Corporation operates fundamentally as a legacy land and royalty trust, deriving its primary corporate revenue from an extensive footprint of surface and mineral acreage in West Texas. The company leverages these perpetual mineral rights to capture unhedged royalties from upstream operator drilling activities, recently yielding 37,100 barrels of oil equivalent per day and generating $237 million in consolidated quarterly top-line revenue without direct capital expenditures. TPL structurally supports this unique asset scale through a dedicated Land and Resource Management segment that oversees approximately 224,000 net royalty acres, reinforced by nearly $900 million in historical capital investments across acquired nonparticipating perpetual oil and gas royalty interests.

linked_companies.name: NATURAL RESOURCE PARTNERS LP
linked_companies.description: Owns, manages, and leases a diversified portfolio of mineral properties, generating royalty income through the extraction of coal, industrial minerals, and other natural resources across the United States.
linked_companies.evidence: Natural Resource Partners structures its primary business operations around its dedicated Mineral Rights segment, which oversees the ownership and leasing of approximately 13 million acres of subsurface rights across the United States. In the most recently reported quarter, this division generated $34 million in net income and $42 million in operating cash flow, completely anchoring the company's consolidated financial output and offsetting equity losses in secondary units like Soda Ash. The company sustains this foundational revenue stream by collecting royalties from lessees extracting coal on its properties and dedicating internal resources toward managing and expanding these passive asset entitlements.

themes.name: Mining Exploration
themes.description: Activities to locate potential mining sites, involving surveys, drilling, and sampling to evaluate ore quality and feasibility.

linked_companies.name: IMDEX LTD
linked_companies.description: Delivers specialized drilling fluids, downhole sensors, and real-time data analytics software designed to optimize drilling operations and enhance subsurface rock knowledge across global mining exploration projects.

linked_companies.name: URANIUM ENERGY CORP
linked_companies.description: Engages in the exploration, evaluation, and development of uranium properties to advance a pipeline of mineral resource projects.
linked_companies.evidence: UEC operates as an Exploration Stage issuer primarily focused on uranium mining exploration, anchored by a regional hub-and-spoke strategy that connects satellite properties to centralized processing facilities. The company actively advances its resource evaluation pipeline, recently allocating $8.04 million over a six-month period to fund a 34,000-meter core drilling program at the Canadian Roughrider Project and extensive delineation drilling at the Sweetwater and Ludeman projects. These exploration initiatives are supported by targeted internal technical hiring and specialized regulatory positioning, notably the FAST-41 designation for the Sweetwater Project which accelerates federal permitting processes.

linked_companies.name: TMC THE METALS CO INC
linked_companies.description: Engages in deep-sea mining exploration focused on assessing and developing polymetallic nodule resources on the seafloor to supply critical metals for battery technologies.
linked_companies.evidence: The Metals Company operates as a pre-revenue deep seabed minerals developer whose business model relies on evaluating seafloor polymetallic nodules. During 2025, the organization directed $40.3 million toward exploration and evaluation expenses, funding offshore surveys, environmental baseline studies, and pilot mining tests. Subsidiaries such as NORI, TOML, and TMC USA execute this strategy by advancing International Seabed Authority exploration contracts and submitting new license applications to NOAA covering 187,017 square kilometers. Through these data collection and regulatory efforts, the company defined the world's first SEC-compliant mineral reserves for a nodule project, establishing a resource base with a $23.6 billion net present value that dictates its projected future revenue.

linked_companies.name: IVANHOE ELECTRIC INC / US
linked_companies.description: Conducts extensive mineral exploration activities, leveraging proprietary geophysical surveying technologies to discover and develop deposits of critical metals essential for global electrification.
linked_companies.evidence: The company's engagement with Mining Exploration is central to its operations, as it identifies itself as a minerals exploration company focused on developing mines primarily in the United States. The company leverages its Typhoon™ geophysical surveying system and advanced data analytics from its subsidiary, Computational Geosciences Inc. (CGI), to enhance its exploration efforts. This includes discovering new deposits of critical metals and supporting American supply chain independence, with exploration activities heavily focused on projects like the Santa Cruz Project, as demonstrated by significant exploration expenses.

linked_companies.name: DENISON MINES CORP
linked_companies.description: Conducts extensive discovery, evaluation, and advancement of mineral properties, dedicating significant operational focus to identifying and developing viable resource deposits.

themes.name: Battery Materials
themes.description: Raw components crucial for the manufacture of batteries, including metals such as lithium, cobalt, and nickel, determining performance, safety, and sustainability of energy storage solutions.

linked_companies.name: CONTEMPORARY AMPEREX TECHN-A
linked_companies.description: Develops and manufactures advanced battery materials and components, supporting the global production of lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles and energy storage systems.
linked_companies.evidence: To secure its supply chain for battery production, CATL directly invests in the extraction, refining, and processing of critical minerals such as lithium, nickel, cobalt, and phosphorus. The company advances its vertical integration through multi-billion RMB equity investments in overseas projects, such as the Indonesia battery industry chain, alongside joint ventures and subsidiaries including CMOC Group and PT. Nickel Cobalt Halmahera. These upstream mining and material synthesis operations produce essential lithium salts, precursors, and cathode materials. Financially, the battery materials, recycling, and mineral resources segments explicitly contribute over RMB 27 billion, representing 6.57% of the company's total revenue.

linked_companies.name: LG ENERGY SOLUTION
linked_companies.description: Focuses on the strategic sourcing, development, and integration of critical battery materials, such as advanced cathodes and anodes, to manufacture high-performance lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles and energy storage systems.
linked_companies.evidence: LGES's involvement in the Battery Materials industry centers on internal R&D and strategic supply chain management. Through its CTO division's Advanced Cell Development unit, the company actively engineers next-generation components, including High-Ni, LFP, and LMR cathodes, fast-charging anodes, and flame-retardant separators. This technological focus is fortified by a 16-year exclusive patent right on a specific nickel-based active material, alongside strategic stakes in joint ventures like PT LBM Energi Baru Indonesia for secondary material manufacturing. Furthermore, LGES manages the procurement of key battery metals—such as lithium, nickel, and cobalt—utilizing fixed-price contracts, derivative hedging, and price pass-through mechanisms to mitigate commodity price volatility.

linked_companies.name: ALBEMARLE CORP
linked_companies.description: Extracts and refines essential lithium compounds, including battery-grade lithium carbonate and lithium hydroxide, supplying critical active materials for the production of lithium-ion batteries used in electric vehicles and energy storage systems.
linked_companies.evidence: Albemarle operates as a primary global supplier of critical battery raw materials, extracting and processing resources into spodumene, lithium carbonate, and lithium hydroxide for electric vehicle and stationary energy storage producers. These materials anchor the company's Energy Storage segment, which accounts for the majority of total enterprise sales and drives a $550 million to $600 million annual capital expenditure budget for capacity expansions at key sites like Greenbushes and La Negra. Executive leadership actively integrates these operations with global critical minerals policies, engaging with governments to build out localized, competitive supply chains. This regulatory alignment supports Albemarle's domestic footprint, positioning U.S. assets like Silver Peak and Kings Mountain to secure federal tax incentives explicitly designated for critical minerals production.

linked_companies.name: GANFENG LITHIUM GROUP CO L-A
linked_companies.description: Supplies critical lithium compounds and metals through vertically integrated operations spanning resource extraction, refining, battery manufacturing, and recycling to support the global electric vehicle and energy storage markets.
linked_companies.evidence: Company 002460's engagement with the Critical Minerals theme is driven by its position as a global leader in lithium production, where its lithium series products account for over half of its total revenue. The company maintains an unmatched vertically integrated scale in battery materials, supported by hundreds of millions of RMB in capital investments directed toward midstream processing lines for battery-grade lithium compounds. Beyond lithium, the company actively expands its upstream resource portfolio through substantial ongoing capital expenditures aimed at extracting and refining other strategic critical minerals, specifically tantalum and niobium.

linked_companies.name: ECOPRO BM CO LTD
linked_companies.description: Manufactures high-nickel cathode active materials that are essential components for lithium-ion batteries, directly supporting the production and advancement of electric vehicles and energy storage systems globally.
linked_companies.evidence: EcoPro BM's alignment with the Critical Minerals theme is rooted in its operations as a specialized manufacturer of battery cathode materials, a product line that accounts for 99.7% of the company's total consolidated revenue. To secure its raw material supply chain, the firm is directing capital toward upstream mineral processing, evidenced by the BNSI Smelter Joint Venture in Indonesia designed to process 66,000 tons of nickel annually and the integration of the Green Eco Nickel subsidiary. Furthermore, the company is scaling its international production capacity through multi-billion KRW infrastructure commitments, including a 54,000-ton capacity cathode plant in Hungary and a dedicated Canadian joint venture, supported by specialized R&D divisions focused on advancing high-nickel and solid electrolyte components.

themes.name: Alternative Investments
themes.description: Investing in asset classes distinct from traditional equities and bonds, encompassing real estate, private equity, hedge funds, and commodities offering diversification.

linked_companies.name: BLACKSTONE INC
linked_companies.description: Manages a comprehensive range of alternative asset classes, including private equity, real estate, credit, and hedge fund solutions, providing non-traditional investment strategies and capital solutions to institutional and individual investors globally.
linked_companies.evidence: Blackstone functions fundamentally as a pure-play alternative asset manager, managing a record $1.3 trillion in assets across more than 90 distinct investment strategies as of Q2 2026. The company structures its entire workforce and operational framework around the alternatives industry, dividing its platform into real estate, private equity, credit, and multi-asset investing, supported by targeted executive appointments such as Joe Dowling heading the multi-asset division. This structural alignment drives the entirety of the firm's operating revenue, further reinforced by Blackstone capturing an estimated 50 percent market share in private wealth alternatives and committing over $11.2 billion in proprietary capital directly into its own alternative investment vehicles.

linked_companies.name: BLUE OWL CAPITAL INC
linked_companies.description: Functions as an alternative asset manager that provides direct lending, GP capital solutions, and real estate investment strategies to institutional and private wealth clients.
linked_companies.evidence: Blue Owl Capital operates as a pure-play global alternative asset manager, dedicating its entire business model to managing private credit, real assets, and GP strategic capital. Underscoring its structural focus on this landscape, the firm raised $57 billion over the twelve months ending in the second quarter of 2026, signaling sustained institutional and private wealth demand for non-traditional strategies. The company continuously scales these dedicated platforms through both direct execution—including $20 billion recently deployed into real assets—and strategic acquisitions such as Atalaya for alternative credit and IPI Partners for digital infrastructure. By managing over $314 billion in exclusively alternative assets and deploying specialized global personnel to distribute interval funds like OWLCX, the entire enterprise is structurally bound to the alternative investments ecosystem.

linked_companies.name: ARES MANAGEMENT CORP - A
linked_companies.description: Manages diverse alternative investment portfolios across private credit, private equity, real estate, and infrastructure, providing specialized capital solutions to middle-market companies and institutional investors globally.
linked_companies.evidence: Ares Management functions entirely as an alternative asset manager, deriving its consolidated revenues from overseeing $644 billion in Assets Under Management across private credit, real estate, infrastructure, and private equity. The firm dedicates nearly 1,700 investment professionals exclusively to originating private market strategies within its diversified alternative platform. To address growing demand across multi-trillion dollar markets, Ares recently introduced 14 new non-traditional investment products over a two-year period. The company further scales its alternative asset capabilities through targeted transactions, demonstrated by the $1.72 billion upfront purchase of GCP International for digital infrastructure and the acquisition of alternative fixed-income manager BlueCove.

linked_companies.name: APOLLO GLOBAL MANAGEMENT INC
linked_companies.description: Structures and manages extensive portfolios across private equity, corporate credit, and real assets, providing specialized yield and equity strategies that expand the availability of alternative investment solutions for global institutional and retail clients.
linked_companies.evidence: Apollo's fundamental corporate identity is anchored in alternative asset management, driven by a dedicated division of roughly 4,000 professionals overseeing over $1 trillion in total AUM across non-traditional credit, equity, and private markets. This core operational focus is physically embodied by the Apollo Aligned Alternatives (AAA) fund, the firm's largest individual vehicle at over $27.5 billion, which functions as the primary alternatives portfolio for its retirement services subsidiary, Athene. The firm aggressively expands its alternatives footprint through strategic initiatives, such as the $1.35 billion acquisition of the alternative asset manager Bridge, alongside hundreds of billions in ongoing institutional capital inflows. Ultimately, these alternative investment products form the absolute foundation of the firm's revenue architecture, generating billions annually in combined fee-related and spread-related earnings.

linked_companies.name: HAMILTON LANE INC-CLASS A
linked_companies.description: Provides comprehensive alternative investment management services, specializing in private equity, private credit, and real assets to deliver customized portfolios and advisory solutions for institutional and private wealth investors worldwide.
linked_companies.evidence: Hamilton Lane operates as a pure-play global private markets investment solutions provider, deriving its entire $758.99 million in revenue directly from alternative asset classes including private equity, infrastructure, and private credit. The firm manages a total asset footprint exceeding $1 trillion, supported by specialized capital vehicles such as a $16 billion Evergreen multi-strategy platform and a $5.6 billion secondary fund. Expanding its institutional presence, the company recently established a decade-long strategic partnership with Guardian to oversee a $5 billion private equity portfolio alongside $500 million in annual private market commitments. Furthermore, the firm structurally reinforces its dedication to this ecosystem by maintaining $272.2 million in direct balance sheet capital commitments to its own alternative investment products.
